trialSelectionNote: Two intervention registrations matched to the EVX-01 program. The first uses the EVAX-01-CAF09b alias and is missed by the exact EVX-01 intervention query. Official UNKNOWN status is preserved for its stale registry record; past estimated completion dates do not establish study completion. Registry rows are distinct from publications and do not establish vaccine-added efficacy.
